data.name: Dinash
data.gender_notes: Dinash is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dinash is derived from the Sanskrit words 'dina' meaning day and 'as' meaning lord or ruler. This name signifies the god of the day or the ruler of the day. The name Dinash carries the meaning “God of the Day” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dinash usually hope their child will grow to embody god of the day and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine ruler of the day and the cycle of life.
data.etymology: Dinash belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of the Day.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dinash total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
